headline: Approved May minutes; a public meeting on the TIF district update is set for 8/17.
summary: The audit engagement has been established, and BillM is giving the auditor information. The Town Manager gave a first reading of a TIF district update resolution, and a public town meeting is scheduled for 8/17. A $64k increase year to date through June 2026 was reported, and July financials are still in progress.
decisions: Approved the May public and non-public minutes, unanimously.

decision_titles: Public and non-public minutes from May
plain_text:
Londonderry Housing and Redevelopment Authority (LHRA)  
Minutes 
Aug 10, 2026  
6:30 PM  
DRAFT  
1) Call to Order – 6:34 
i) DePasse, Mee, Root, Powers in attendance 
2) Administrative  
a) Reading and Approval of both public and non-public Minutes from May 
i) Motion by ChrisP second by GregD, unanimously passed 
 
3) Old Business  
a) Audits  
i) The engagement with auditor has been established. BillM has been providing 
information to them. 
b) Enterprise lease 
i) Town Manager had ﬁrst reading of a TIF district update resolution.  Next step is a 
Public town meeting scheduled for 8/17. 
4) Financials 
a) May and June Financials just received.  Not enough time to review prior. 
b) July still in progress. 
c) $64k increase YTD through June 2026 
 
5) New Business  
a) None 
 
6) Adjournment: next meeting Sep 14, 2026, 6:00pm  
a) Motion to Adjourn at 6:57pm– made by GregD, seconded by ChrisP, unanimously 
approved
